title: Temporary granted by Turn to Dust expires at end of turn, so the gear is never killed
expected: At HEAD (cbd38e3), packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/grant-keyword.ts:34 is `const duration = (effect.duration ?? "turn")`. The parser emits Turn to Dust's effect as {type:'grant-keyword', keyword:'Temporary', target:{type:'gear'}} with no duration (verified by running parseAbilities on the rulesText), so the grant is recorded with duration:'turn'. riftbound-flow.ts:613-620 (ending phase) then filters out every grantedKeyword with duration === 'turn', so by the controller's next Beginning Phase the Temporary grant is gone and the kill loop at riftbound-flow.ts:274-312 (which checks grantedKeywords for 'Temporary') never matches the Serrated Dirk. This exactly matches the observed meta {keyword:'Temporary',duration:'turn'} disappearing after endTurn. Note: the working tree has an UNCOMMITTED edit at grant-keyword.ts:34-39 defaulting Temporary to 'permanent' (rule 816.1.b) which would fix this, but it is not in HEAD.
observed: After resolution the gear's meta showed grantedKeywords:[{keyword:'Temporary',duration:'turn'}]; after endTurn the grantedKeywords entry was gone and at turn 5 beginning->main the Serrated Dirk was still in base (trash count unchanged at 1 = the spell itself). The kill never happened.

history.note: Temporary grants default to permanent duration (rule 816.1.b) + regression test
